subject: Estimating factor scores in Mixture IRT

messages.author: 67d02c83646f5c7e
messages.subject: Estimating factor scores in Mixture IRT
parts:
Hello Phil, 

Thanks for the great package and your elaborate responses on all the questions on this forum!

Im having a small issue calculating ability parameters/factor scores from a mixture Rasch model. In the code block below, i simply copied the code from the documentation on the multipleGroup() function, and inspect the theta estimates. Surprisingly, all theta estimates are within 4e-07 of zero. The same happens when i try to apply the same model to my own data. Is there something im overlooking or is this a bug? I am using mirt 1.39. 

Thanks in advance!
Karel

# Mixture model (no prior group variable specified)
set.seed(12345)
nitems <- 20
a1 <- matrix(.75, ncol=1, nrow=nitems)
a2 <- matrix(1.25, ncol=1, nrow=nitems)
d1 <- matrix(rnorm(nitems,0,1),ncol=1)
d2 <- matrix(rnorm(nitems,0,1),ncol=1)
itemtype <- rep('2PL', nrow(a1))
N1 <- 500
N2 <- N1*2 # second class twice as large
dataset1 <- simdata(a1, d1, N1, itemtype)
dataset2 <- simdata(a2, d2, N2, itemtype)
dat <- rbind(dataset1, dataset2)

# Mixture Rasch model (Rost, 1990)
models <- 'F1 = 1-20
CONSTRAIN = (1-20, a1)'
mod_mix <- multipleGroup(dat, models, dentype = 'mixture-2', GenRandomPars = TRUE)

theta_hat = fscores(mod_mix) # theta estimates
#plot(density(theta_hat))
print(range(theta_hat))
[1] 5.072241e-72 3.476044e-07

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Estimating factor scores in Mixture IRT
parts:
Hi Karel,

My apologies for this bug, it was recently introduced by changing the default for latent class models that should have only returned the classification probabilities. I've patched it on the dev version, which returns the previously correct behaviour. Thanks for the report!

Phil
